contract: Frozen upload acceptance, same-binary storage controls and matched MPS snapshots.
model: Bias-free single-head unmasked pre-RMSNorm encoder; separate Q/K/V and output projections; attention softmax; two residuals; explicit epsilon and scale; unit RMS gain; 4x ReLU FFN. No KV cache, masks, tokenizer or generation.
timing: Warm whole-block execution including selected uploads and cleanup. Shared policies allocate and CPU-copy a fresh owned snapshot. No output readback in timing. Private controls use the existing blit path. No arithmetic/compiler/task changes.
